name: Bank Transfer (TED) Plugin API
description:
# Bank Transfer (TED) Plugin for Lerian Platform

Enable Brazilian bank transfers (TED OUT, TED IN, P2P) through Lerian platform with:
- **TED OUT**: Send transfers to any Brazilian bank via JD Consultores SPB
- **TED IN**: Receive transfers from any Brazilian bank
- **P2P**: Same-institution transfers (same ISPB, faster and cheaper)

## Key Features
- Real-time transfer status tracking
- Automatic fee calculation via plugin-fees
- BACEN operating hours compliance (Mon-Fri 06:30-17:00 UTC-3)
- Duplicate transfer prevention
- Transaction limits enforcement
- Multi-tenant architecture (SaaS, BYOC Single, BYOC Multi)

## Integration Pattern: Two-Step Flow

1. **InitiateTransfer** - Calculate fee, get confirmation
2. **ProcessTransfer** - Execute with user approval

This pattern ensures users see fees before committing funds.

## Authentication
- Optional via lib-auth (customer configurable)
- Bearer token with JWT containing `tenantId` claim

## Multi-Tenant Headers (Required)
All endpoints require:
- `X-Organization-Id`: UUID (must match JWT `tenantId`)
- `Authorization`: Bearer token (if auth enabled)

## Error Handling
All errors follow standard format with `code` (BTF-XXXX), `title`, `message`, and optional `fields`.

## Rate Limiting
- Rate limits configured per organization
- 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header

## Environments
- **Development**: http://localhost:3000
- **Staging**: https://api-staging.lerian.io/bank-transfer
- **Production**: https://api.lerian.io/bank-transfer

## References
- PRD: Gate 1 - Product Requirements
- Feature Map: Gate 2 - 21 Features, 7 Domains
- TRD: Gate 3 - Technical Architecture
- API Design: Gate 4 - Technology-agnostic contracts
- Data Model: Gate 5 - Entity definitions

## Support
- Documentation: https://docs.lerian.io/plugins/bank-transfer
- Support: support@lerian.io
